liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Other One** (2 reviews): Reviewer says this sounds better than most of the tape and goes far out; Reviewer calls this performance amazing [13][16]
- **Mexican Hat Dance** (1 review): Reviewer is delighted by the band's cover of this tune [12]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Described as a rocking performance in the soundboard excerpt [14]
- **Sing Me Back Home** (1 review): Donna sings backup vocals, and Garcia's solo is described as beautiful [14]

## Setlist highlights

- **Rockin' Pneumonia & The Boogie Woogie Flu**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 3 archived performances [17]
- **Mexican Hat Dance**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 4 archived performances [17]

## The recordings

- **gd1972-05-24.pye-jones.harper-sirmick.87027.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 23 songs; 145 min; rated 2.8/5 by 5 [1]. Said about its sound: Sound is compared to a friend phoning from the show; someone, perhaps the taper, can be heard singing along; Reviewer calls the recording a tough listen overall [11][13]
- **gd72-05-24.jones.macdonald.5920.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 23 songs; 146 min; rated 2.5/5 by 8 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the audience recording poor quality and not worth downloading, though fine for streaming; Reviewer says this song is heavily cut, and there is some high scratchy noise elsewhere; Reviewer finds the sound horrible compared with other 1972 shows [6][9][10]
- **gd1972-05-24.aud.jones.macdonald.sirmick.24068.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 23 songs; 146 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1972-05-24.sbd-pset2.unknown.91509.flac16**: soundboard; 9 songs; 80 min; rated 4.56/5 by 9 [4]. Said about its sound: Soundboard portion is stereo with an excellent mix; Andy Lemieux remaster of the soundboard excerpt sounds better; the complete show is otherwise only in poor audience tapes [14][15]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended this as their first Grateful Dead show, on their 18th birthday, with a girl named Melony [7]
- Uploader's list shows Truckin' through Sugar Magnolia, then Turn On Your Love Light, with One More Saturday Night as encore [2]
- Taper Chris Jones can be heard throughout the show [3]
- Says the Strand run was a good close to the tour, and some tunes reportedly ended up on Euro 72 and Steppin Out [6]
- Notes some of the show appears on the official release Steppin Out, while the full show lacks a high-quality source [7]
- Reviewer finds the sound much better than the 4/7/72 and 4/14/72 recordings, with instruments reasonably clear [9]
- Says the three-night London stand was great, yet only audience tapes circulate, with no professional recordings of it [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1972-05-24.pye-jones.harper-sirmick.87027.flac16**: taped by Chris Jones; transferred by Graham Harper and SIrMick; source: aud > Pye mono cassette recorder (crappy model) with hand-held mike > mac [1]. Also: Taped on an inexpensive hand-held recorder in a large crowd, over 35 years ago; Remastered from raw wav files sent by Chris, using iZotope Ozone and Waves Z-Noise; cuts and wow and flutter remain [1][11]
- **gd72-05-24.jones.macdonald.5920.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience [2]. Also: Mono audience tape on a Pye cassette recorder with hand-held mike, then Ampex reel-to-reel, CD-R, EAC; taped by Chris Jones [2]
- **gd1972-05-24.aud.jones.macdonald.sirmick.24068.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Chris Jones; transferred by Graham Harper and SirMick; source: ono crappy Pye cassette recorder with hand-held mike > ampex R2R [3]. Also: Remastered from Alasdair MacDonald's original seed using Wavelab and DirectX plugins; tracks trimmed and retracked [3]
- **gd1972-05-24.sbd-pset2.unknown.91509.flac16**: transferred by Andy Lemieux; source: MSR>DAT>CDR>EAC>.WAV>TLH>.FLAC [4]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Europe '72: Strand Lyceum, London, England May 24, 1972](https://www.dead.net/features/listening-party/europe-72-strand-lyceum-london-england-may-24-1972) [18]
- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1972-05-24 Wed Lyceum, London, England](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1376174963806/grateful-dead-1972-05-24-wed-lyceum) [19]
- Poster by music-tw.line.me: [One More Saturday Night (Live at the Strand Lyceum, London, England, May 24, 1972) - Grateful Dead 死之華合唱團 - The Very Bes](https://music-tw.line.me/track/1024882013) [20]
